hover:opacity-80 max-sm:text-body-sm" aria-expanded="false"><span>What is Bland AI?</span><span class="text-secondary flex items-center shrink-0 transition-transform duration-[var(--duration-normal)] ease-default "><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6L8 10L12 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" min-h-0"><p class="font-body text-body-sm leading-[1.6] text-secondary pb-5 max-w-[640px]">Bland is an enterprise voice AI platform. Customers use it to build, run, and monitor AI phone agents that hold real conversations at scale. Agents work inbound and outbound, sound human, run on Bland's own infrastructure, and plug into the tools your team already uses.</p></div></div></div><div class="border-b border-border"><h3 class="text-wrap"><button class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 w-full py-5 cursor-pointer font-display text-body font-medium tracking-heading text-dark text-left bg-transparent border-none hover:opacity-80 max-sm:text-body-sm" aria-expanded="false"><span>How does per-minute pricing work?</span><span class="text-secondary flex items-center shrink-0 transition-transform duration-[var(--duration-normal)] ease-default "><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6L8 10L12 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></button></h3><div class="grid transition-[grid-template-rows] duration-[var(--duration-slow)] ease-default grid-rows-[0fr]"><div class="overflow-hidden min-h-0"><p class="font-body text-body-sm leading-[1.6] text-secondary pb-5 max-w-[640px]">One per-minute rate covers the language model, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and telephony. There are no per-token charges, no per-feature surcharges, and no separate vendor invoices. Pricing scales with usage. Enterprise plans are contracted based on volume, dedicated infrastructure, and compliance requirements.</p></div></div></div><div class="border-b border-border"><h3 class="text-wrap"><button class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 w-full py-5 cursor-pointer font-display text-body font-medium tracking-heading text-dark text-left bg-transparent border-none hover:opacity-80 max-sm:text-body-sm" aria-expanded="false"><span>How long does it take to deploy a Bland agent?</span><span class="text-secondary flex items-center shrink-0 transition-transform duration-[var(--duration-normal)] ease-default "><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6L8 10L12 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></button></h3><div class="grid transition-[grid-template-rows] duration-[var(--duration-slow)] ease-default grid-rows-[0fr]"><div class="overflow-hidden min-h-0"><p class="font-body text-body-sm leading-[1.6] text-secondary pb-5 max-w-[640px]">Most production agents go live in two to six weeks, depending on how complex the conversation flow is. Bland's Forward Deployed Engineer team builds the customer's first agent end to end. They own the pathway, the integrations, and the test loop with your ops team. You're not stitching it together yourself.</p></div></div></div><div class="border-b border-border"><h3 class="text-wrap"><button class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 w-full py-5 cursor-pointer font-display text-body font-medium tracking-heading text-dark text-left bg-transparent border-none hover:opacity-80 max-sm:text-body-sm" aria-expanded="false"><span>How does Bland handle HIPAA, PCI, and SOC 2?</span><span class="text-secondary flex items-center shrink-0 transition-transform duration-[var(--duration-normal)] ease-default "><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6L8 10L12 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></button></h3><div class="grid transition-[grid-template-rows] duration-[var(--duration-slow)] ease-default grid-rows-[0fr]"><div class="overflow-hidden min-h-0"><p class="font-body text-body-sm leading-[1.6] text-secondary pb-5 max-w-[640px]">Bland holds independently audited SOC 2 Type I and Type II reports, is HIPAA compliant, and self-attests to PCI DSS v4.0.1. Its security program also covers ISO 27001:2022, GDPR, and FedRAMP Class A, with evidence for each available through the Trust Center. The platform was built around these standards, not retrofitted to them. Self-hosted and on-premises deployments are available for the most sensitive workloads. BAAs and DPAs are in place for healthcare and EU customers.</p></div></div></div><div class="border-b border-border"><h3 class="text-wrap"><button class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 w-full py-5 cursor-pointer font-display text-body font-medium tracking-heading text-dark text-left bg-transparent border-none hover:opacity-80 max-sm:text-body-sm" aria-expanded="false"><span>Can Bland replace my call center?</span><span class="text-secondary flex items-center shrink-0 transition-transform duration-[var(--duration-normal)] ease-default "><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6L8 10L12 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></button></h3><div class="grid transition-[grid-template-rows] duration-[var(--duration-slow)] ease-default grid-rows-[0fr]"><div class="overflow-hidden min-h-0"><p class="font-body text-body-sm leading-[1.6] text-secondary pb-5 max-w-[640px]">Yes. Companies run full AI call centers on Bland: agents answer thousands of concurrent calls, handle routine requests end to end, and route edge cases to humans with full context. Bland works as a standalone AI contact center or alongside your existing team and telephony.</p></div></div></div><div class="border-b border-border"><h3 class="text-wrap"><button class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 w-full py-5 cursor-pointer font-display text-body font-medium tracking-heading text-dark text-left bg-transparent border-none hover:opacity-80 max-sm:text-body-sm" aria-expanded="false"><span>How is Bland different from an IVR?</span><span class="text-secondary flex items-center shrink-0 transition-transform duration-[var(--duration-normal)] ease-default "><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6L8 10L12 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></button></h3><div class="grid transition-[grid-template-rows] duration-[var(--duration-slow)] ease-default grid-rows-[0fr]"><div class="overflow-hidden min-h-0"><p class="font-body text-body-sm leading-[1.6] text-secondary pb-5 max-w-[640px]">An IVR makes callers navigate menus with a keypad. Bland replaces it with conversation: callers state what they need, and the agent understands, acts, and resolves in natural language. Companies typically replace their IVR first, then expand the same agent across the full call volume.</p></div></div></div><div class="border-b border-border"><h3 class="text-wrap"><button class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 w-full py-5 cursor-pointer font-display text-body font-medium tracking-heading text-dark text-left bg-transparent border-none hover:opacity-80 max-sm:text-body-sm" aria-expanded="false"><span>Does Bland replace humans or work alongside them?</span><span class="text-secondary flex items-center shrink-0 transition-transform duration-[var(--duration-normal)] ease-default "><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6L8 10L12 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></button></h3><div class="grid transition-[grid-template-rows] duration-[var(--duration-slow)] ease-default grid-rows-[0fr]"><div class="overflow-hidden min-h-0"><p class="font-body text-body-sm leading-[1.6] text-secondary pb-5 max-w-[640px]">Bland is designed to handle 100% of calls. Most customers ramp there gradually. They start with high-volume, repeatable work like appointment booking, intake, IVR replacement, and identity verification. Complex edge cases route to humans with full context. Over time, the agent absorbs more of the workload.</p></div></div></div><div class="border-b border-border"><h3 class="text-wrap"><button class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 w-full py-5 cursor-pointer font-display text-body font-medium tracking-heading text-dark text-left bg-transparent border-none hover:opacity-80 max-sm:text-body-sm" aria-expanded="false"><span>Does Bland support languages other than English?</span><span class="text-secondary flex items-center shrink-0 transition-transform duration-[var(--duration-normal)] ease-default "><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6L8 10L12 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span></button></h3><div class="grid transition-[grid-template-rows] duration-[var(--duration-slow)] ease-default grid-rows-[0fr]"><div class="overflow-hidden min-h-0"><p class="font-body text-body-sm leading-[1.6] text-secondary pb-5 max-w-[640px]">Bland supports 40+ languages natively, with real-time translation available in 23 of them. Agents can switch languages mid-call when needed. TTS voices are available for every supported language, and custom voice clones can be trained per language.</p></div></div></div></div></div></section></div><section class="hpv5-section bg-fog" aria-labelledby="hpv6-final"><div class="hpv6-frame"><div class="grid grid-cols-12 items-start gap-x-8 gap-y-10 max-lg:grid-cols-1"><h2 id="hpv6-final" class="hpv6-display col-span-6 max-lg:col-span-1">Dedicated infrastructure for your <span class="whitespace-nowrap">high-stakes</span> calls</h2><div class="col-span-6 col-start-7 flex flex-col items-start gap-8 max-lg:col-span-1 max-lg:col-start-1"><p class="hpv6-body-lg text-secondary">Your calls run on Bland’s own models, on infrastructure dedicated to you. The platform was built around these standards, not retrofitted to them. Self-hosted and on-premises deployments are available for the most sensitive workloads. BAAs and DPAs are in place for healthcare and EU customers.\"},{\"question\":\"Can Bland replace my call center?\",\"answer\":\"Yes. Most customers ramp there gradually. They start with high-volume, repeatable work like appointment booking, intake, IVR replacement, and identity verification. Complex edge cases route to humans with full context.
